blockingFindings.title: Missing shared writer coverage for next-action CAS
blockingFindings.issue: The T-3 test strategy explicitly requires extending `tests/unit/flow/flow-state-shared-writer.test.js` for maxAttempts bounds, invalid pre-write validation, CAS drift, one-promotion, and no-duplicate retry assertions, but that shared writer test is not in the touched file set and no equivalent shared writer owner coverage is shown.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Add or update `tests/unit/flow/flow-state-shared-writer.test.js` with the required next-action shared writer cases, or include equivalent shared writer-owner tests in the touched set that exercise FlowStore CAS behavior directly for invalid, drift, exact success, and retry/no-duplicate behavior.
blockingFindings.rationale: R9 requires spec-local, shared get-next-action/writer tests, and full regression coverage. The missing shared writer test is an explicit acceptance requirement, so this is a blocking requirement gap.
